main_text.p: æquitatisq; contentione,aut propter scripti à non scripto iure diffensionem nascitur. Nos utriusque insignia quæ-dam exempla proferemus: quorũ similitudine studio-si postea, defumptas ex anti-quis scriptoribus controver-sias tractare poterunt. Pri-mùm igitur de Iuris æquita-tisq; contentione videamus.

Lex est: In privato iudicio præiudiciû publico iudicio ne fiat. Cũ ad vim quotidia-nam faciendam quidam ar-mati venissent, armati con-tra præstò fuerunt, & cuidã equiti R. quidam ex armatis resistenti gladio manû præ-
main_text.notes: Handwritten ink annotations in the right margin (beside lines 9 to 10) are illegible and are not transcribed. The printed « marks at the line ends in the right margin (lines 14 to 19) are quotation markers, not text, and are not transcribed. The page number "11" at top right is uncertain. The "h" and "ci-" at the foot are the signature and catchword. Printed text: "contentione,aut" is set without a space in the print.
